title: Design Ticketmaster / Flash-Sale Booking
subtitle: Virtual waiting room, atomic Redis seat holds with TTL & ACID checkout finalization
functionalReqs: Browse upcoming events, venues, and live interactive seat map.
Select seats and hold them exclusively for 10 minutes while entering payment details.
Finalize booking atomically—never oversell or double-book a seat.
Absorb 500k+ concurrent users hammering a concert drop at 10:00:00 AM without crashing DB.

nonFunctionalReqs.target: Strict strong consistency on seat assignment
nonFunctionalReqs.rationale: Two buyers paying for Seat A12 ruins customer trust and creates legal refunds.
Ticket drops concentrate months of demand into 30 seconds.
Abandoned carts must return seats to inventory automatically.

workedSummary.dropSpike: 500k waiting users × seat-map polling -> absorbed at Edge Waiting Room & CDN
workedSummary.actualCheckoutQps: Limited to ~2,000 admitted buyers/sec matching venue inventory
workedSummary.seatMapSize: 50,000 stadium seats × 100 B = ~5 MB (fits trivially in Redis / CDN edge JSON!)

apiContracts.purpose: Acquire atomic 10-minute Redis + DB hold for selected seat_ids (requires waiting-room JWT)
Verify hold token, charge card via PSP, and atomically transition seats HELD -> BOOKED

explorerTopology.title: Flash-Sale Waiting Room & Atomic Seat Hold Flow
explorerTopology.subtitle: Edge queue admission -> Redis Lua seat hold -> ACID Postgres booking
explorerTopology.overview: Letting 500,000 users lock rows in Postgres simultaneously creates catastrophic lock queues. Instead, an Edge Virtual Waiting Room admits bounded batches via signed queue tokens, CDN caches static seat maps, Redis Lua grants sub-millisecond 10-minute seat holds, and Postgres enforces final ACID booking + idempotency.
keyTakeaways: Put a Virtual Waiting Room at the CDN/Edge tier to throttle admission to what downstream checkout can sustain.
Hold seats atomically in Redis (`SET seat:e1:A12 hold_id NX EX 600`) before touching Postgres payment flows.
Verify `hold_token` AND `status != BOOKED` inside Postgres ACID checkout so an expired Redis hold can never double-sell.

nodes.label: 500k Concert Fans
nodes.summary: Fans entering queue, watching live SSE queue position, then picking seats.
failureModes: Bot scripts flooding `/holds` without waiting-room token

nodes.label: Edge Waiting Room
nodes.summary: Assigns randomized/FIFO queue number, absorbs 99% spike at edge, and issues short-lived signed admission JWTs.
whenToUse: Protecting finite inventory from 100x demand spikes
failureModes: Sharing leaked admission JWTs unless bound to user_id

nodes.label: Booking & Hold Service
nodes.summary: Validates queue JWT, runs multi-seat Redis Lua hold, and orchestrates PSP charge + SQL commit.
failureModes: Slow PSP call after hold nears 600s expiry unless checked inside final SQL commit

nodes.label: Redis Hold & Map Cache
nodes.summary: All-or-nothing Lua script atomically locks all requested seats (`A12, A13`) for 600s.
whenToUse: Fast temporary cart locks with auto-TTL
failureModes: Redis node loss without persistence could forget active holds—Postgres final check guards!

nodes.label: Postgres Event Ledger
failureModes: Never let unthrottled 500k users execute `SELECT FOR UPDATE` directly here

steps.info: 500k fans wait at Edge; batch #1 receives signed queueToken (valid 15m)
steps.inspectorNote: 498,000 queued fans never touch origin compute or SQL—saving infrastructure from collapse.

steps.info: Lua script verifies [A12, A13] are free and sets EX=600s hold atomically
steps.payloadInspector: EVALSHA hold_seats 2 seat:ev99:A12 seat:ev99:A13 -> OK (hold_id=h_442, ttl=600s)
steps.inspectorNote: Using a Lua script ensures either BOTH adjacent seats A12 & A13 are held together or NEITHER is locked.

steps.info: Payment succeeds -> UPDATE seats SET status='BOOKED' WHERE status!='BOOKED' -> COMMIT!
steps.payloadInspector: ACID Tx: 2 seats confirmed BOOKED | Idempotency-Key chk_91 committed
steps.inspectorNote: Checking `status != 'BOOKED'` inside Postgres guarantees zero double-booking even if a user took 10m05s to submit payment!

chaosScenarios.title: User Pays Right After 10-Min Hold Expires (Zero Double-Sell)
chaosScenarios.triggerSummary: User A's Redis TTL (600s) expires at 10:10:00 while User B immediately grabs A12 and checks out; at 10:10:02 User A's slow checkout hits Postgres.
chaosScenarios.mitigationSummary: Postgres ACID conditional update (`WHERE status='AVAILABLE' OR (status='HELD' AND hold_id=$1)`) detects A12 is already BOOKED by User B and triggers an instant refund/re-pick to User A.

steps.info: UPDATE seats WHERE seat_id='A12' AND status!='BOOKED' -> 0 rows updated!
steps.payloadInspector: Seat A12 already BOOKED by User B -> Return 409 Conflict + auto-void PSP auth
steps.inspectorNote: Never rely solely on Redis TTL for financial finality—Postgres ACID acts as the unbreakable final invariant.

tradeoffs.option: Edge Waiting Room + Redis Lua Hold + SQL Finalize
cons: Needs signed queue tokens + eventual seat map UI refresh (1–2s lag ok)
tradeoffs.bestFor: Concerts, sports drops, limited sneaker/flash-sale launches

tradeoffs.option: Pure Postgres Pessimistic Locking (`SELECT FOR UPDATE`)
cons: Connection pool collapses immediately at >10k concurrent drop users

deepDives.title: Broadcasting Live Seat Map Availability Without Hammering DB
deepDives.bottleneck: 50,000 admitted fans refreshing the stadium SVG map every 2 seconds = 25,000 read QPS on seat status.
deepDives.solution: Represent an event's 50,000 seat statuses as a compact bitset/hash in Redis (`~5 MB`), pushed/cached at CDN/SSE edge every 1–2s—while checkout validates exact availability atomically.
deepDives.tradeoff: A seat can show green for 1 second after someone grabs it, caught cleanly in <1ms by the atomic Redis Lua hold.

deepDives.title: Preventing Bot Cart Hoarding
deepDives.bottleneck: Scalper bots grab and renew 10-minute holds forever to lock out real fans.
deepDives.solution: Limit max holds per `user_id`/`device_fp`, deny hold extensions, require payment-intent pre-check or Edge bot challenge before granting queue token.
deepDives.tradeoff: Tighter anti-bot gates add minor friction while ensuring fair fan inventory rotation.

criteria: Adds Edge Virtual Waiting Room before origin
Explains signed queue token + rate shaping
Uses Redis Lua multi-seat NX lock + TTL
Sizes ~5 MB seat map cache cleanly
Guards final checkout with Postgres ACID condition
Caches seat map reads at edge/Redis
